contracts: HAVING aggregate occurrences have separate borrowed full-Expr-node identities from selected aggregates. Whole-tree admission precedes every cursor, including rejected predicates and unsupported later arms.

Only HAVING states accumulate during source input. Checked EOF and full group-key policy/completion cohorts precede final predicate evaluation. False/Unknown drops operation-local retained rows without constructing/pushing/finishing selected aggregate states or evaluating selected scalar projections.

Accepted groups replay paid moved retained rows in original encounter order and selected syntactic occurrence order through existing kernels. Raw/Error cells, field indices, declarations and policy completion remain intact; no AST rewriting, stored-schema coercion, source snapshot cache or named-prefix cache is introduced.

Pure scalar/key and Count(*)-only selections retain checked per-group signed counts without replay rows. Accepted Count(*) slots retain ordinary Int64 carrier and separate node identities. Queries without HAVING retain their prior state layout and allocation path.

TOP counts HAVING-accepted groups while later accepted omitted groups still evaluate operands and final projections. Rejected groups still evaluate HAVING. Failed source/EOF and sticky typed source/sink/query failures preserve existing stage/arm stop and lexical-owner restoration.

HAVING operands retain explicit progressive row-major scan-phase timing rather than buffered aggregate-at-a-time access. Accepted projection operands retain progressive operand-before-final-expression phases; no claim of identical cross-row/native error priority.
independent_controls: False/NULL HAVING suppresses projected Sum/Avg/Min/Max/Count operand errors, scalar division, invalid raw publication and missing format policy; rejected projection-only required text providers are never resolved.
Selective groups replay only their own input populations. HAVING-only five-aggregate populations use independent integer answers; empty global population differs from empty keyed groups.

Independent late String policy/completion models distinguish HAVING and projection populations. Raw/Error aggregate nullness and final observers retain existing cells and aggregate declaration boundaries.

Accepted TOP counting, later omitted accepted-group errors, scan-vs-final HAVING eager failures, EOF priority, every observed cancellation checkpoint, typed sink stops, repeat execution and UNION arm isolation are exercised.

Count(*) HAVING scans 100,001 rows with an 8 KiB query allowance; projected Sum(N) replay consumes its declared byte budget even when final HAVING rejects. Original no-HAVING Count8KiB and all current numeric/extrema/grouped/derived controls pass.
